newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SEV TO HOST 3RD EURO-MED INDUSTRIAL SUMMIT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SEV TO HOST 3RD EURO-MED INDUSTRIAL SUMMIT.

text.p: The Federation of Greek Industries (SEV) will organise the Third Euro-Mediterranean Industrial Summit in Athens on October 6 and 7, it said in a statement on Wednesday.
The summit will be attended by industrial representatives from European Union (EU) and non-EU or southern Mediterranean countries, it added.

It will examine the issues of foreign investment, commerce, medium- and small-sized enterprises, energy, the environment, infrastructure, education and training. Specific proposals for action plans will be placed, it added.

These proposals will be submitted for financing under the Mediterranean Development Assistance regulation (MEDA), which was established by the European Commission to promote the realisation of a Euro-Mediterranean Free Transactions Zone.
The implementation of this zone depends on successful interaction between EU and non-EU member countries in areas such as industry, education, training and infrastucture.
MEDA has alloted to this purpose 3.4 billion ecus for the period from 1995 to 1999. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
